attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB 10.5 Galera cluster on node1-node3 (AlmaLinux 9, mariadb-server + mariadb-server-galera + galera from appstream), bootstrapped on node1 with sample appdb.items data, and joined node2/node3 via mariabackup SST (required opening firewalld ports 3306/4567/4568/4444 and a custom SELinux module to permit the mariadb-backup connectto AVC that was blocking SST). Added node4 as a fourth member: installed the same packages, configured galera.cnf with wsrep_cluster_address including node4, and it joined via SST carrying the full existing dataset (cluster_size 4, Synced/Primary) and was confirmed to accept writes that replicated to the other members. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured a boot_id + cluster-health baseline on all 4 nodes, then rebooted them one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirming a changed boot_id and full quorum/Synced/Primary recovery (with pre-existing data intact) before moving to the next node. A final write on node1 after all restarts replicated correctly to node4.
